title: Design: Long contact names stay in their rows in Sending invoice
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with three contacts whose email addresses you can read: contact B1, whose first and last name together are long with spaces, at least 40 characters, contact B2, whose first name is long with no spaces, at least 30 characters, and contact B3, whose last name includes the characters & " ' < > (for example O'Neil "Jr" <Parts> & Co).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billed to customer B.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p5-12-after-sending-invoice-s2-17581.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the invoice's email (send) window on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The window lists customer B's contacts, contact B1, contact B2 and contact B3, each with its name and email address.
  • Each contact's name and email stay inside the contact's own row: no part of them covers the row under it or that row's tick box.
  • Contact B3's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.
  • The window's buttons are fully visible.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12311 (Story 9, Invoice email to the Bill To)

  • S9-R1: “The send window lists the Bill To's contacts.”

Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p5-12-after-sending-invoice-s2-17581.png

The design's own words:

  • “Lists the Bill To's contacts and ticks "George Thomas" (Valders): its Billing contact, else its first.”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
